about.storyHeading: I started with *one small project*. Now I help teams ship work they're proud of.
about.story:
Experienced Splunk Administrator managing and troubleshooting production environment issues, ensuring smooth monitoring , administration and resolution of production issues. Skilled in working with Azure-integrated Splunk environments, handling various Azure services like Virtual Machines (VMs), Logic Apps, VMSS, Storage, and network-related services.

Proficient in onboarding indexes in Splunk, creating alerts, and configuring saved searches as per stakeholder requirements. Experienced in user access management and enforcing compliance policies to ensure adherence to security standards. I focus on maintaining a stable, responsive environment, adhering to strict timelines to meet stakeholder expectations.

Strong knowledge of Incident, Problem, and Change Management processes, ensuring minimal downtime and swift issue resolution. Skilled in working within multiple team environments, effectively syncing with live progress on requirements. Adept at handling adhoc requirements under pressure and delivering timely solutions for business needs.

Passionate about leveraging my technical expertise and experience to optimize processes, enhance system reliability, and drive business success.

privacy.text:
This policy explains what personal data {name} collects through this website, why, and the choices you have.

## Who we are

{name}
{address}
Phone: {phone}
Email: {email}
GSTIN: {gstin}
CIN: {cin}

## What we collect

- **Technical data:** basic information your browser sends to any website, such as its type and the pages requested. Optional cookies and similar tools are used only after you allow them in the consent banner.

## Why we use it

- to answer your enquiry or booking request
- to keep the website secure and stop misuse
- to meet our legal and tax duties

We use your details only for these purposes. We do not sell personal data.

## Who we share it with

Only with those who help us run this service:
- the companies that host this website and its database
- authorities, when the law requires it

## How long we keep it

Enquiries are kept for as long as needed to answer them. After that they are deleted.

## Your rights

You can ask us for a copy of your personal data, ask us to correct or delete it, withdraw a consent you gave, and name another person to act for you. In India these rights come from the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. To use them, or to raise a grievance, write to us using the details above. If you are not satisfied with our answer, you may approach the Data Protection Board of India.

## Children

This website is not meant for children, and we do not knowingly collect their data without a parent's or guardian's consent.

## Changes

We may update this policy. The date below shows when it was last changed.

Last updated: {date}
